{{Quote|I've heard the Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden is worth seeing.''"<br />"''Yeah, well, don't figure you're going to get time to read all the exhibit signs.|[[Ganner Rhysode]] and Corran Horn|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>}}
The '''Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden''' was a garden located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pesktda]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. A set of [[bafforr tree]]s was located at the gardens. When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Garqi|attacked Garqi]], the local defenders and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] made a stand at the gardens. The battle was short, though, as the bafforr trees soon unleashed pollen that attacked the [[Warrior caste|warriors]]' [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|vonduun crab armor]]. To prevent the Yuuzhan Vong from learning of bafforr pollen's effects on Yuuzhan Vong armor, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] ordered the gardens to be burned, but he knew it was just a matter of time before the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Ithor|attacked]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].<ref name="DT2:R" />
